suggested_experiment_name: WISPy CDM combined ALP constraints (CAST+Sumico, Haloscope, HB, Optical, x_ion, X-rays, EBL)
coupling_convention: g (ALP-photon coupling) in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the Log10 g [GeV^-1] axis
notes: This is primarily a theory/phenomenology paper (Arias et al. 2012, arXiv:1201.5902) mapping regions where ALPs and hidden photons produced via misalignment can be cold dark matter. It does derive some new constraints (ALP decay bounds from EBL, optical, X-ray, reionization 'xion' in the m_phi-g plane; reinterpretation of axion haloscopes for hidden photon DM in the m_gamma'-chi plane), but all limits are presented only as regions in Figures 1, 3, and 5 with no numerical tables or explicit limit values in the text. The paper covers TWO coupling types (AxionPhoton g in GeV^-1 and DarkPhoton kinetic mixing chi), which further reduces confidence. No reliable (mass, coupling) pairs can be extracted from the text alone; limits would need to be digitized from the figures. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of the combined exclusion regions') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 1 of 'WISPy Cold Dark Matter' (Arias et al. 2012). Axes: Log10 m_phi [eV] from -9 to +8, Log10 g [GeV^-1] from -20 to -5. Traced the lower envelope of the combined exclusion regions: CAST+Sumico floor at g~6e-11 GeV^-1 across 1e-9 to ~0.1 eV; narrow Haloscope (ADMX) dip near 2-6 ueV reaching g~1e-15; 'Optical' DM-decay dip near 2-4 eV; x_ion and X-ray/EBL DM-decay bounds descending steeply above ~20 eV, reaching the plot bottom (1e-20 GeV^-1) near 1.6e6 eV (1.6 MeV). Many of the constraints above ~1 eV assume ALPs constitute the DM. Confidence reduced because the envelope combines several overlapping regions read visually from the plot; individual segment edges have ~0.1-0.2 dex uncertainty. | Calibration: No calibration needed (benchmark KSVZ raw_ratio=0.96 snapped to identity)
